purpose: Collect cited developer-problem signals for human topic selection; never create, edit, draft, or publish content.

watchlist.topic: procedural game asset review and pipeline validation

guardrails: Keep a source URL and capture date for every signal.
Treat discussion volume as a hypothesis, not keyword volume or demand proof.
Never scrape search-result pages, Reddit, or gated sites.
Never write to the content ledger, briefs, drafts, or site from this job.
A human chooses whether any ranked packet becomes a research brief.
